focus.name: title-menu-graphics-extents
focus.purpose: Bound the title/menu palette and selection-marker graphics directly consumed by startup and options presentation services.

evidence: Render_ApplyPaletteBandStep publishes four 0x20-byte bands from the direct title source.
Render_UploadPaletteBand0 copies exactly 16 words for each direct scene/menu source.
Menu_AnimateSelectionMarkerTiles wraps VDP_ANIMATION_FRAME_OFFSET at 0x38 and copies 15 words per selected frame.
The four ranges form one gap-free 0x00129CEA-0x00129DFF region immediately before the unresolved zero/data tail.
limitations: The individual title/menu color roles are not split beyond the verified upload service and consumer.
The following zero-filled/data region beginning at 0x00129E00 is not claimed.
